description: The lineup: newer models with a new architectural feature, and the version before each. Every model runs on a local machine with 16 GB at 16-bit precision. Original checkpoints only, at the precision their vendor published.

pairs.change: Full attention on all 28 layers (GQA, 8 KV heads) becomes a hybrid: 18 Gated DeltaNet layers that keep a fixed-size memory instead of a growing cache, and 6 full-attention layers with 2 KV heads and a sigmoid gate on their output.

pairs.feature: MoE with a shared expert + sliding-window attention
pairs.change: Both route every token through a sparse MoE. Granite 3.1 3B-A800M sends each token to 8 of 40 experts on all 32 full-attention layers (GQA, 8 KV heads). Granite Swash 3B-A600M sends it to 4 of 48 experts plus an always-on shared expert, and 20 of its 28 layers attend over a 128-token sliding window with 4 KV heads, so its cache stops growing on those layers.
